title: RadixFlow: Filling Execution Bubbles in Prefix-Cached Hybrid LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2610.18143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prefix reuse improves LLM inference by sharing the KV cache of common prompt prefixes. This helps only if the scheduler can execute a matched branch in the current worker round. Schedulers assume that a matched prefix is ready, which holds for full attention but fails for hybrid LLMs. There, a branch (the consumer) may need recurrent state that another branch (the producer) is still computing in the same round. The native scheduler stops its waiting-queue scan at this blocked consumer, and the resulting head-of-line blocking creates \emph{execution bubbles}: idle batch slots that independent work could fill. We introduce RadixFlow, which decouples prefix matching from state readiness. Its state-ready traversal turns a global scan barrier into a local wait: only the consumer is blocked until the next round, while feasible independent branches keep filling the batch under the native state check. translated_title: RadixFlow：填补前缀缓存混合LLM服务中的执行空泡
translated_abstract: 前缀复用通过共享公共提示前缀的KV缓存来提升LLM推理效率，但只有在调度器能在当前worker轮次中执行匹配到的分支时才会有效。调度器假设匹配到的前缀是就绪的，这对完全注意力模型成立，但在混合LLM中却不成立。在混合LLM中，某个分支（消费者）可能需要另一个分支（生产者）仍在同一轮次中计算的循环状态。原生调度器在遇到这个被阻塞的消费者时就停止了对等待队列的扫描，由此产生的队头阻塞会造成“执行空泡”：即本可由独立任务填充的空闲批处理槽位。我们提出了RadixFlow，它将前缀匹配与状态就绪性解耦。其状态就绪遍历机制将全局扫描屏障转变为局部等待：只有消费者会被阻塞到下一轮次，而可行的独立分支则在原生状态检查下继续填充批处理。在五个混合模型上，RadixFlow降低了平均……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RadixFlow通过将前缀匹配与状态就绪性解耦，把混合LLM服务中的全局扫描屏障转化为局部等待，消除了队头阻塞造成的执行空泡，从而提升推理吞吐量。
en_tdlr: RadixFlow decouples prefix matching from state readiness in hybrid LLM serving, turning a global scan barrier into a local wait to eliminate execution bubbles caused by head-of-line blocking and improve throughput.
